senses.gloss: m. (פְּטַר) dismissal from school, reading of Scriptures and prayers at dismissal.—Pl. מִפְטָרֵי.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 53b:30">Ber. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>בעידן מִפְטָרַיְיהוּ</he> (Ms. F. <he>דקא מִפַּטְּרֵי</he>) at the time of their dismissal with devotional exercises; <he>בדלא עידן מ׳</he> (Ms. F. <he>דקא מגמרי להו</he>) not at dismissal (when they recite merely for practice).
